_metadata.description: Read-only evidence composition: sync-snapshot + manual-attestation readers, the OT × requirement × validation × evidence matrix join, drift/staleness/unproven-claim derivation.

requirements.title: Evidence artifacts are read-only
requirements.description: business-health reads coverage/requirements-sync/latest.json and coverage/manual-validations/log.jsonl but never writes any coverage/ path except the manual-validations ledger it owns via manual-log; test-genie remains the single writer of run evidence.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/evidence/readonly_test.go. Static assertion that the evidence package makes no write calls to sync-snapshot paths; manual-log writes only to coverage/manual-validations/.

requirements.title: Traceability matrix join
requirements.description: One pure join implementation composes OT × requirement × validation × latest evidence and backs all four surfaces (report CLI, assessment findings, UI matrix, fleet rollups); no surface re-derives the join.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/matrix/matrix_test.go. Fixture-tested joins including missing snapshot, zero-requirement scenario, and multi-module registries.

requirements.title: Staleness and expiry model
requirements.description: Snapshot age vs latest suite run and manual-attestation expiry (policy owned by business-health) are explicit, tested models; stale evidence yields advisory findings, dishonest statuses yield required findings.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/evidence/staleness_test.go. Edge cases: expired manual attestation, snapshot older than latest run, missing snapshot.

requirements.title: Unproven-claim derivation
requirements.description: An OT checked [x] with no passing linked requirement, a requirement whose only evidence is an expired manual attestation, and statuses hand-edited against the sync writer are derived as unproven claims and surfaced in matrix, findings, and fleet views.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/matrix/unproven_test.go. One fixture per unproven-claim shape.

requirements.title: Contract-side inspection verbs
requirements.description: report (json|markdown|summary), drift, phase, and manual-log run against the new internals with output parity to the absorbed test-genie verbs; manual-log appends attestation identity to the business-health-owned ledger.

validation.notes: Planned ref: cli/domains/requirements/requirements_test.go. Golden outputs for report formats; manual-log append + identity assertions.
